info.title: fsharp-ballast
info.description: Measures Abstractness, Instability, Distance from the Main Sequence and effectfulness for F# and C# projects and solutions.

options.name: --level
options.description:
what counts as a component: project, namespace or
module (default: namespace).

options.name: --profile
options.description:
what counts as abstract: functional or classic
(default: functional).

options.name: --format
options.description:
report format: table, json, csv or html (default:
table).

options.name: --output
options.description: write the report to this file instead of the console.

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: include test projects, which are left out by default.

options.name: --include-external
options.description: count dependencies on NuGet packages as coupling.

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
leave components whose name matches this glob out of
the report. Repeatable.

options.name: --framework
options.description:
target framework to analyse (default: the project's
first).

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: do not run dotnet restore first.

options.name: --distance-threshold
options.description:
distance beyond which a component is given a zone, 0
to 1 (default: 0.5).

options.name: --max-distance
options.description:
exit with code 1 if any component's distance exceeds
this, 0 to 1.

options.name: --effect-threshold
options.description:
under the functional profile, effectfulness beyond
which a stable concrete component is in the Zone of
Pain, 0 to 1 (default: 0.25).

options.name: --no-recommendations
options.description:
leave the recommendations out of the report: the
section in table and html, the advice column in csv
and the recommendations object in json.
